bounds: Eight timezone scenarios cover a known or absent prior zone and one owner statement naming a zone, its alias, or no zone. Six travel scenarios cover ordinal, plain and ISO dates, an omitted date and an impossible ordinal date, with one fixed reporting clock and one later scheduling tick. Conformance sends generated statements through the real owner.profile_extraction evaluator on PGlite. It reads persisted facts and compares the calendar zone or scheduling travel status. The steps assume an authenticated owner, successful local storage, one message at a time and an explicit tick. Model-extracted facts, concurrent messages, other date forms and clock changes remain outside the model.

assumptions: The owner evaluator and the later scheduling read eventually run when enabled. Storage succeeds.
Without fairness, the evaluator or the scheduling read can stall indefinitely.
